claim_support_checks.claim: VM restore points provide granular backup and retention policies, distinct from sitewide disaster recovery solutions.
Application consistency is supported for Windows VMs using VSS writers and for Linux VMs using pre- and post-scripts.
Cross-region copying of VM restore points is in public preview and does not support private links.
You can exclude specific disks when creating a restore point using the --exclude-disks parameter in Azure CLI.
Restoring a VM involves creating new disks from disk restore points and then creating a new VM with those disks.
